correctness.rationale: In upper half plane y=1, order three samples and set consecutive gaps u=LTP,v=LT(1-P); the joint ordered density6 with Jacobian T makes T~Beta(2,2), P uniform independent, Q|T=t uniform(0,1-t). Angle defects yield A(u,v)=2[atan(u/2)+atan(v/2)-atan((u+v)/2)]. As L→∞, arctan(2/u) gives the asserted Z pathwise; solving P(1-P)>=4/(zT+4) yields exact cdf support z>=12. Direct conditioning shows zP(Z>z)→24 and p<1 integrability; common majorant yields subcritical moment convergence, Fatou gives divergence above threshold. Beta gap marginals produce finite-L expectation integral; asympt integrals yield coefficient 24log(L/2)-24. For TV marked law transform v=zTmin(P,1-P)/4 on two symmetric rare intervals; unconditioned density exactly24/z per binary label with support converging to 0<v<1, so Scheffe applies. Fresh independent quadrature checked z survival products 20:17.4714,100:23.2232,1000:23.9472,10000:23.9951 and mean errors shrink from 1.0958 at L100 to .00565 at L20000; finite diagnostics do not prove total variation.
